title: Cryptid-Themed Adventure Game Announces With Smash Hit Trailer

Press release

10/29/2026

Explore a parallel dimension where Bigfoot, Mothman, and other cryptids really do exist

Explore a parallel dimension where Bigfoot, Mothman, and other cryptids really do exist in We Don't Exist, an upcoming story-driven adventure game for PC/Steam solo developed by artist Versiris.

Play as famous cryptids— inspired by real-world paranormal legends—in addition to your own customizable human character. Interact with a wide cast of voiced characters in conversations with dynamic dialogue choices. Explore, gather data, and help your cryptid companions unravel an interdimensional conspiracy. 

With the game gathering over 10,000 wishlists on Steam and announcement trailer garnering over 500,000 views on YouTube in its first few days, the game's reveal is already captivating audiences with its stylized characters and blend of hand-drawn 2D art with 3D environments.

Game Features:
 A Lore-Rich World: Explore a strange new world of cryptids, UFOs, and other elusive phenomena and meet characters based on real-world paranormal legends.
Character Customization: Enter the world as your own player character with a variety of customization options.
Take On Multiple Roles: Play as famous cryptids including Mothman, Jersey Devil, and more—each with their own character arcs and interconnecting stories. 
Dynamic Conversations: Converse with characters that feel alive. Respond your way with dynamic dialogue options. They'll remember what you say—even your likes and dislikes. 
Voiced Characters: Interact with a wide variety of hand-drawn voice-acted characters, all with their own personalities and stories.
Explorable Areas with Side Stories: Free roam around the diverse areas of the cryptid world as you progress the main story. Take a break to talk to locals and take on optional but rewarding side stories.
Collectibles Galore: Collect data on the strange creatures you meet. Trade goods, favors, and even secrets for useful intel or unique items to help you on your adventure.

About the Dev:
We Don't Exist is being made by solo developer Tanya Kozak under her artist moniker Versiris. Based out of Philadelphia, USA, she has been a professional artist and online creator for over a decade with clients like Blizzard Entertainment, Sony Interactive, and previous industry experience shipping games as part of the art team on Drinkbox's Guacamelee (2013) and Guacamelee 2 (2018). She started teaching herself Unreal Engine in her spare time and is the sole artist, animator, programmer and designer on We Don't Exist.
